5.7.5.16 OsTaskExecutionEvent
Purpose: The RunnableEntity triggered by a OsTaskExecutionEvent is supposed to react on the execution of specific OS Tasks. Signature:
[SWS_Rte_82008] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072
⌈
void <name>([IN Rte_Instance <instance>])
⌋
Notes: The runnable entity triggered by an OsTaskExecutionEvent reacts on the execution of the OS Task to which it is mapped. The main use case for this event is scheduling of RunnableEntitys of complex drivers which have to react on task executions.
